Good afternoon Sion,
Thank you for your email dated 28/09/2026 that has been fowarded to us to issue a reply to your Subject Access Request.
Please note that in order for us to process your request we will need the following:

  *   We require a clear digital photograph of your Identification which may include your Driving Licence, Passport, or a copy of your full birth certificate.
  *   We require proof of your current address e.g. utility bill / bank statement (dated within the last 3 months).
The easiest way for you to submit your request and the required documents is to use the link below.
This will ensure that you have provided the relevant information for the Data Protection Team to process your request and that it will be submitted directly to us, rather than to other areas of the force which may cause unnecessary delays.
Ask for information about yourself | South Wales Police<https://www.south-wales.police.uk/rqo/request/ri/request-information/ir/ask-for-delete-change-information/ask-for-information-about-yourself/?tid=828402&lid=&cid=&rid=5&stepid=1-1-2>

Kind regards

Tîm Diogelu Data | Data Protection Team
Uned Rheoli Data a Datgeliadau | Data Management and Disclosure Unit
Pencadlys Heddlu De Cymru | South Wales Police Headquarters

Ymateb nad yw'n Argyfwng\ Non-Emergency Response

Oes angen i chi siarad â'r heddlu ond nid oes angen ymateb brys arnoch? Gallwch roi gwybod am fater drwy ein gwefan https://www.heddlu-de-cymru.police.uk<https://www.heddlu-de-cymru.police.uk/>, neu ffonio 101. Do you need to speak to the police but don't require an emergency response? You can make a report via our website https://www.south-wales.police.uk<https://www.south-wales.police.uk/>, or call 101. 101 can be used to report a non-emergency to any force in Wales and England. In an emergency always dial 999.
